description: The site’s only text-block layout: a shrink-to-fit flex column with a max-width cap and a 12/16/20px row-gap between a heading and its body. There is NO prose/typography plugin anywhere — paragraph margins, list markers, list indentation and li gaps are all 0 via Tailwind preflight.

maxWidth.note: 860px on the legal pages, a literal CMS `section_max_width` px value elsewhere
